# AI

> NPC movement over PathfindingService.

- Package: `AI` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("AI")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.AI`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/AIService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local AI = GaxiaServer.AI
```

### Functions

- `AI.ComputePath(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, agentParams: AgentParams?): ({ PathWaypoint }?, string)`
  Returns the waypoint list (or nil) + the PathStatus name. Pure-ish: no model, just geometry — easy to assert on.
- `AI.MoveTo(model: Model, target: Vector3, agentParams: AgentParams?): boolean`
  Walk `model` to `target`, following the path. Yields until arrival, an 8s per-waypoint Humanoid timeout, or cancellation (Stop / a newer command). Returns true if the route completed.
- `AI.Stop(model: Model): ()`
  Halt the model's current movement.
- `AI.IsMoving(model: Model): boolean`
- `AI.Roam(model: Model, center: Vector3, radius: number): () -> ()`
- `AI.Follow(model: Model, target: Instance, opts: { Interval: number?, StopDistance: number? }?): () -> ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `AI.OnReached` — `Signal<Model, Vector3>`
  (model, target) after MoveTo walks the whole route (not when cancelled)
